none.comment: Initial release of `@excom/vite-plugin-nucleus`: `nucleus()`, the Vite plugin that builds, serves and previews a Nucleus Stack site (pages, Quark modules, a bundled service worker, the Nucleus Kit bundled or loaded from unpkg), with `@excom/vite-plugin-nucleus/host` to serve a build as Cloudflare Workers static assets do and `@excom/vite-plugin-nucleus/css` for the shared CSS config
